description: One named group of fields inside a form: a `fieldset` with a visible legend, an optional sentence, and a `<FormStack>` of Fields inside. Copy: the section title groups the questions under it in the reader's terms, and the description says why they are asked together.

props.name: title
props.description: The group's name: who or what these fields are about.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence on why the group exists, when the title cannot carry it.

example:
const [name, setName] = useState('Delivery review')
const [area, setArea] = useState('emea')<FormSection title="Ownership" description="Who this workspace belongs to.">
  <Field label="Workspace name" htmlFor="ws-name" required>
    <Input id="ws-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
  </Field>
  <Field label="Area">
    <Select label="Area" options={AREAS} value={area} onChange={setArea} />
  </Field>
</FormSection>
